WITH a AS (SELECT CAST(regexp_extract(text, '([0-9]+\.[0-9]+) mAh/g', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS cap FROM lines WHERE id='p6.L27'),
b AS (SELECT CAST(regexp_extract(text, '([0-9]+\.[0-9]+)%', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS pct FROM lines WHERE id='p6.L28')
